DECLARE

 v_date DATE:=to_date(RTrim(LTrim(:global.eff_date)),'mm-dd-yyyy');

BEGIN

 If :vpc_block.procedure_code is not null and :vpc_block.eff_date is not null
 Then 
 IF :vpc_block.procedure_code = v_proc and :vpc_block.eff_date =v_date then
 NULL;
 ELSE
 If :vpc_block.term_date is null or :vpc_block.term_date > sysdate then
 If db_check(:vpc_block.procedure_code,to_char(:vpc_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'))
 Then
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure; 
 Else
 If NVL(:vpc_block.procedure_code,'') !=NVL(v_proc,'') OR
 NVL(:vpc_block.eff_date,'') !=v_date 
 Then
 If v_proc is not null and v_date is not null then
 DUP_DELETE_RG(v_proc,to_char(v_date),to_char(v_tdate));
 End if;
 DUP_INSERT_RG(:vpc_block.procedure_code,to_char(:vpc_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'),
 to_char(:vpc_block.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'));
 End if; 
 End if; 
 End if;
 END IF;
End if;
END;

PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
d_chp_sysdate date;
begin
 
 d_chp_sysdate:=lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc( d_chp_sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then

 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;

 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 if term_date < trunc(d_chp_sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_SEQ_NO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION check_seq_no RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
 rg_name VARCHAR2(20) := 'PROC'; 
 rg_col1 VARCHAR2(20) := 'PROC.SEQ'; 
 rg_col2 VARCHAR2(20) := 'PROC.EDATE'; 
 rg_col3 VARCHAR2(20) := 'PROC.TDATE'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 rowcount NUMBER:=0; 

 Procedure create_record_group is
 h_rg RECORDGROUP;
 h_gc1 GROUPCOLUMN;
 h_gc2 GROUPCOLUMN;
 h_gc3 GROUPCOLUMN;
 Begin
 h_rg := FIND_GROUP('PROC');
 IF ID_NULL(h_rg) THEN
 h_rg := CREATE_GROUP('PROC');
 ELSE
 DELETE_GROUP(h_rg);
 h_rg := CREATE_GROUP('PROC');
 END IF;
 h_gc1 := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(h_rg,'SEQ',CHAR_COLUMN,5);
 h_gc2 := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(h_rg,'EDATE',CHAR_COLUMN,10);
 h_gc3 := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(h_rg,'TDATE',CHAR_COLUMN,10);
 End;

BEGIN

 create_record_group;

 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rowcount:=GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('PROC');
 END IF;

 -- Create the entries in the record group
 go_block('vpc_block');
 first_record;
 Loop
 If :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT','CHANGED') then
 rowcount:= rowcount + 1;
 Add_Group_Row( rg_id, END_OF_GROUP ); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col1, rowcount, to_char(:vpc_block.sort_sequence)); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col2, rowcount, to_char(:vpc_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col3, rowcount, to_char(:vpc_block.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')); 
 End if;
 
 If :system.last_Record='TRUE' then 
 exit;
 else
 next_Record;
 end if;
 End Loop;


 -- Check for duplicate entry
 
 go_block('vpc_block');
 first_record;
 rowcount:=GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('PROC');
 Loop
 nCount:=0;
 FOR i in 1 .. rowcount Loop

 If Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col1,i) = to_char(:vpc_block.sort_sequence) then
 if sysdate between to_date(Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col2,i),'mm-dd-yyyy') and
 nvl( to_date(Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col3,i),'mm-dd-yyyy'),sysdate+1) then
 nCount:= nCount + 1; 
 end if;
 End if; 
 End Loop;

 if nCount > 1 then 
 return(TRUE);
 end if; 

 if :system.last_record='TRUE' then 
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;

 End loop;

 RETURN(FALSE);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_INSERT_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_insert_rg(plProc in varchar2,plEDate in varchar2,plTDate in varchar2) IS
 rg_name VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPC'; 
 rg_col1 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPC.CODE';
 rg_col2 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPC.EDATE'; 
 rg_col3 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPC.TDATE'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 rowcount NUMBER; 
 DUP_RECORD VARCHAR2(1):='N';
 VCount NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN 
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 

 rowcount:=GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('VPC');
 FOR i in 1 .. rowcount Loop
 
 If Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col1,i) = plProc THEN
 if sysdate between to_date(Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col2,i),'mm-dd-yyyy') and
 nvl( to_date(Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col3,i),'mm-dd-yyyy'),sysdate+1) then

 DUP_RECORD:='Y'; 
 exit;
 end if;
 End if; 
 End Loop;

 If DUP_RECORD ='Y' then 
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure; 
 Else
 Add_Group_Row( rg_id, END_OF_GROUP ); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col1, rowcount+1, plProc); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col2, rowcount+1, plEDATE); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col3, rowcount+1, plTDATE); 
 End if;
 END IF; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_DELETE_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_delete_rg(plProc in varchar2,plEDATE in varchar2, plTDate in varchar2) IS
 rg_name VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPC'; 
 rg_col1 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPC.PROC';
 rg_col2 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPC.EDATE'; 
 rg_col3 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPC.TDATE'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 rowcount NUMBER; 
BEGIN 
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rowcount:=GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('VPC');
 message(to_char(rowcount));pause;
 For i in 1.. rowcount Loop
 If Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col1,i) = plProc AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col2,i) = plEDate AND
 NVL(Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col3,i),'X') = nvl(plTDate,'X') then
 delete_group_row(rg_id,i);
 exit;
 End if;
 End Loop;
 END IF; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_REC_VALIDATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_rec_validation IS
 v_proc VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.procedure_code));
 v_date DATE:=to_date(RTrim(LTrim(:global.eff_date)),'mm-dd-yyyy');
 v_tdate DATE:=to_date(RTrim(LTrim(:global.term_date)),'mm-dd-yyyy');
BEGIN

 If :vpc_block.procedure_code is not null and :vpc_block.eff_date is not null
 Then 
 If not check_existing_data then
 
 If :vpc_block.term_date is null or :vpc_block.term_date > sysdate then
 
 If db_check(:vpc_block.procedure_code,to_char(:vpc_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'))
 Then
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure; 
 Else
 
 If NVL(:vpc_block.procedure_code,'') !=NVL(v_proc,'') OR
 NVL(:vpc_block.eff_date,'') !=v_date 
 Then
 
 If v_proc is not null and v_date is not null then
 DUP_DELETE_RG(v_proc,to_char(v_date),to_char(v_tdate));
 End if;
 End if; 
 DUP_INSERT_RG(:vpc_block.procedure_code,to_char(:vpc_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'),
 to_char(:vpc_block.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')); 
 End if; 
 End if;
 End if;
End if;
END;

 v_tdate DATE:=to_date(RTrim(LTrim(:global.term_date)),'mm-dd-yyyy');
BEGIN

 NVL(:vpc_block.eff_date,'') =v_date Then
 return (TRUE);
 Else
 return (False);
 End if; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DB_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION db_check (lProc in varchar2,plEDATE in varchar2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 vCount NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN

 select nvl(count(*),0) into vCount from valid_proc_codes where
 procedure_code = lProc and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);

 IF vCount > 0 then 
 RETURN (TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN (FALSE);
 END IF;
END;
